blocking_gaps.title: H0b Locked Forward Prediction Absent
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Does an independently calibrated, established transformation-aware NiTi constitutive model (Auricchio / Graesser-Cozzarelli) coupled to Coulomb friction adequately predict moment-curvature loops, tangent stiffness, and slip thresholds under variable confinement pressure?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Auricchio UMAT in Vahidi et al. 2022; Kang et al. 2020 FEM; no locked forward comparison has been conducted against pressure-controlled bundle bending.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: If H0b is adequate within experimental tolerance, the distinct MP1 mechanics claim collapses entirely; H1 cannot be claimed while H0b remains an unfalsified viable competitor.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Execute a numerical benchmark of H0b with locked parameters on declared pressure-curvature paths and compare against experimental data with predefined error metrics.

blocking_gaps.title: Mechanism Non-Identifiability from Macroscopic M-kappa Data
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Can macroscopic moment-curvature softening curves uniquely isolate stress-induced Martensitic phase transformation from inter-wire frictional slip, cross-sectional ovalization, and membrane compliance?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Astra critique G04 and Stage 3 W08 demonstrate that global M-kappa response is observationally degenerate; softening can be produced by multiple uncoupled mechanisms.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: Claims of coupled constitutive-contact mechanics based solely on global load-deflection or moment-curvature measurements are scientifically invalid and unidentifiable.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Implementation of an instrumentation protocol combining global bending with local state observables (core FBG strain sensors, surface DIC, infrared thermal imaging, LVDT end-slip).

blocking_gaps.title: Pressure-to-Normal-Force Mapping (p -> f_n) Uncertainty
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: How quantitatively does positive chamber pressure p transmit through the elastomeric membrane into internal inter-wire normal contact forces f_n across the bundle cross-section under bending?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Stage 3 W05 mechanics derivation; hoop stress in membrane and void arching in multi-wire packing significantly attenuate and redistribute contact forces nonlinearly with curvature.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: Without an identified p -> f_n mapping, pressure cannot be treated as a known mechanical contact variable in constitutive equations or numerical simulations.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Independent pressure-transfer calibration using radial pressure-film sensors, wire pull-out force tests under variable chamber pressure, and cross-section FEA.

blocking_gaps.title: Parameter Leakage and Compensation under Free Fitting
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: How can mutual compensation between friction coefficient mu, pressure transfer ratio alpha_trans, contact penalty stiffness k_n, and NiTi transformation plateau parameters be prevented from producing false goodness-of-fit?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Astra critique G08; Fang et al. 2019 macromodel parsimony analysis; W09/W10 Stage 3 remediation.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: Post-hoc free fitting allows a deficient model to match experimental data via unphysical parameter combinations, masking true model error and preventing causal falsification.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Strict enforcement of the Locked Calibration Rule: measure mu, single-wire superelastic parameters, and pressure transmission in separate independent non-bending tests, then freeze them before evaluating bending response.

blocking_gaps.title: Slip-Transformation Coexistence Feasibility Domain
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Does there exist an accessible, durable physical operating domain (curvature kappa, pressure p, temperature T, wire diameter d) where inter-wire slip and stress-induced phase transformation occur simultaneously without membrane burst or wire fatigue?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Stage 3 W06 derivation shows transformation requires outer fiber strain > 0.75% (curvature > 0.01 mm^-1 for typical wires), below which the bundle degenerates to ordinary elastic wire jamming (H0a).
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: If the bundle cannot physically operate in the coexistence regime, the core scientific phenomenon does not exist in practice and the topic degenerates to known linear elastic jamming.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Experimental mapping of the (p, kappa, T) operating envelope demonstrating robust cycle life and simultaneous slip and transformation.

blocking_gaps.title: Thermal and Loading-Rate Confounding of Hysteresis
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Can the latent heat of NiTi phase transformation (L ~ 10-25 J/g) and self-heating/cooling during cyclic bending be decoupled from mechanical frictional dissipation and rate-independent hysteresis?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Silva et al. 2022; Liu et al. 2026; Astra critique G12. NiTi transformation stress varies with temperature at dsigma/dT ~ 6-8 MPa/C.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: Thermal drift during bending cycles changes both stiffness and hysteresis loop shape, confounding friction and phase transformation mechanisms.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Strict quasi-static loading rate control (eps_dot < 10^-4 s^-1) to ensure isothermal conditions, verified by surface thermocouple/IR thermography, or fully coupled thermomechanical modeling.

blocking_gaps.title: Existing Cable/Contact Formulation Sufficiency
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Are existing continuum and structural beam stick-slip contact formulations (e.g. Tjahjanto et al. 2017, Barsi et al. 2025, Xin Liu 2004) already capable of capturing pressure-dependent bundle bending simply by incorporating the nonlinear tangent modulus of NiTi?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Barsi et al. 2025 short wire rope formulation; Tjahjanto et al. 2017 submarine cable core formulation.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: If incremental beam theory with nonlinear wire stiffness is analytically sufficient, no new field theory or micro-coupling law (H1) is required.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Mathematical formulation analysis comparing classical incremental stick-slip kinematics with coupled phase-transformation kinematics to identify any missing coupling term.

blocking_gaps.title: Local Observable Measurement Feasibility under Sealed Pressure Envelope
blocking_gaps.scientific_question: Is it experimentally feasible to embed local sensors (e.g. FBG optical fibers, internal contact transducers, or end-slip encoders) inside an active positive-pressure membrane without compromising pressure seal, altering internal packing, or damaging sensors during cyclic bending?
blocking_gaps.current_evidence: Astra W2-09 challenge; W2-03 identifiability audit.
blocking_gaps.why_blocking: If local observables cannot be measured in the actual sealed bundle, mechanism identifiability (GAP-02) cannot be achieved.
blocking_gaps.what_would_resolve_it: Physical prototype design and verification of a sealed sensor feedthrough and non-intrusive embedded sensing layout.
